what: The nearby-page rule on Sonarr's 12 page-gap bugs (fix file findable, no picked page cites it): where the walk from the real fix files lands, and a fresh agent's verdict (D61) on whether that page helps a developer understand the code the fix is in. Walk: NearbyWalk (reverse slice lines, hub stop). Verdicts: helps / partly (same area, nothing on the mechanism the fix changes) / no.
pattern: The import list sync page was handed out for 4 bugs (SONB-11, 17, 29, 33); all 4 fixes are in provider code (Simkl, Trakt) that page never describes. Dead ends: SONB-18 (database converters, migrations, a static constructor), SONB-32 (housekeepers run through command dispatch), SONB-35 (stopped at a hub; an earlier walk without the hub stop reached a page that helps).
judge: fresh agent, read ticket, page and fix files; strict on topical overlap
